what: The marker box behind the emphasized word is painted from the left in 1.4s expo.out, and .2s later the letters inside light up one by one in shuffled order (.02s apart) — when lit they start as white like the background, then .15s later over .1s change to a color matching the marker (accent color · text color). Every heading and card marker uses this one effect

options.delay: Time from the box fill starting until the text lights up (sec), default .2
options.each: Delay per step in the staggered order (seconds), default .02 — hero large marker .01, long paragraph marker .005
options.hold: Seconds from the text turning on until its color changes, default .15
options.on: view (default, once the head reaches screen center+25%) · load (right on attach) · state (when the user side adds is-in)
options.start: When view, the ScrollTrigger start, default top center+=25%
options.--fx-mark: Marker box color (via style), default var(--kf-ink)
options.--fx-from: Text color when on, default var(--kf-surface)
options.--fx-to: Text color after the change, default var(--kf-accent)

note: The original ease ‹step(1)› is not a name in GSAP, so text color changes with the default curve power1.out in .1s — power1.out exactly as seen on screen. Text is split into inline-block word chunks, with the spaces between left as they are.

from.where: Markers for all headings, statements and cards (original registerEffect setMarker · inMarker · setMarkerText · inMarkerText)
